spec: Implement `session_transfer`: a transfer requires a valid session (the user must be known and the one-time code correct), then the ledger debits the source account when funds suffice, returning the new balance as Ok(new_balance); otherwise it returns Err("insufficient funds"). The session service validates the one-time code for known users (user ids below 1000, otp equal to 123456); the ledger debits amounts up to the balance. The caller must detect when a service's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: session_validate
externs.contract:
requires user_id > 0
requires otp >= 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (user_id < 1000 and otp == 123456)
externs.contract_py: lambda user_id, otp, out: (out[0] == 'ok') == (user_id < 1000 and otp == 123456)

externs.name: ledger_debit
externs.contract:
requires balance >= 0
requires amount >= 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (amount <= balance)
ensures (not is_ok(result)) or unwrap_ok(result) == balance - amount

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} session_validate(user_id: int, otp: int) returns (result: Result<(), string>)
  requires user_id > 0
  requires otp >= 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (user_id < 1000 && otp == 123456)

method {:extern}{:axiom} ledger_debit(balance: int, amount: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires balance >= 0
  requires amount >= 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (amount <= balance)
  ensures !result.Ok? || result.value == balance - amount
